chapter.title: OF THE EXCLUSION OF ORAL BY DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE

heading: Saving of provisions of Indian Succession Act relating to wills.
text:
Nothing in this Chapter contained shall be taken to affect any of the provisions of the Indian Succession Act, 1865 [1](10 of 1865) as to the construction of wills.
PART III
PRODUCTION AND EFFECT OF EVIDENCE
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
